subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw continue persisting full `systemPromptReport` in every session entry for warning dedupe, or move/trim that durability to a smaller canonical field?
rationale: Current tests encode full-report persistence as intentional, while production comments show the same field dominates `sessions.json` size; automation should not choose the durability boundary alone.

options.title: Persist only dedupe state
options.body: Store the small warning-signature state needed after restart and omit or rebuild the large tools/skills/system-prompt report from inactive session rows.

options.title: Keep full report inline
options.body: Accept the current `sessions.json` size tradeoff and handle bloat through pruning/entry caps instead of changing report durability.

options.title: Move report out of line
options.body: Store report details in a canonical non-index store with cleanup semantics, avoiding a new ad hoc JSON sidecar unless maintainers approve the storage shape.

recommendation.title: Persist only dedupe state
recommendation.body: Store the small warning-signature state needed after restart and omit or rebuild the large tools/skills/system-prompt report from inactive session rows.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commit metadata ties this owner to both the prompt-blob mitigation and session-store evolution, making them the best available decision owner from the history pass.
